symbols.name: Controller reader
symbols.detail: Strobes $4016, then reads eight bits from both controllers; entry point.

symbols.name: Read controllers twice
symbols.detail: Invokes the $AB83 controller reader twice; entry point.

symbols.name: Two-sample button filter
symbols.detail: Keeps only buttons present in both samples and reports newly pressed buttons separately from those still held.

symbols.name: MMC1 serial write ($ACBD)
symbols.detail: One of four routines that send five serial bits to MMC1 register regions, configuring mirroring and program/graphics bank selection; entry point.

symbols.name: MMC1 serial write ($ACD1)
symbols.detail: One of four routines that send five serial bits to MMC1 register regions, configuring mirroring and program/graphics bank selection; entry point.

symbols.name: MMC1 serial write ($ACE5)
symbols.detail: One of four routines that send five serial bits to MMC1 register regions, configuring mirroring and program/graphics bank selection; entry point.

symbols.name: MMC1 serial write ($ACF9)
symbols.detail: One of four routines that send five serial bits to MMC1 register regions, configuring mirroring and program/graphics bank selection; entry point.

symbols.name: Indirect four-byte copy
symbols.detail: Copies four bytes through two indirect pointers; on the checked route the destination is the pulse 1 register block.

symbols.name: Frame sequencer setup
symbols.detail: Writes $C0 to $4017: five-step frame sequencing with the frame interrupt inhibited (single instruction site).

symbols.name: APU register initialization
symbols.detail: Initializes the DMC DAC, pulse/noise envelope registers and triangle linear-counter register.

symbols.name: Pulse volume/envelope update
symbols.detail: Updates pulse volume/envelope through an indexed store during the observed music/effects sequence (single instruction site).

symbols.name: Indexed channel register writer
symbols.detail: Writes $4000,Y through $4003,Y at $E98E, $E994, $E99A and $E9A0; Y selects pulse 1, pulse 2 or triangle.

symbols.name: Noise register writes
symbols.detail: Writes noise envelope, period and length/restart at $E9F3, $E9F9 and $E9FF.

symbols.name: Reset handler
symbols.detail: Reset vector target: clears decimal mode, disables IRQ handling and PPU output, waits through two PPUSTATUS polls and initializes the stack; entry point.
